title: AI agent teaser, terminal boot
description: A terminal-style teaser for an AI product: the problem, the agent at work, the outcome.
prompt: Open on a blinking prompt and the one-line problem, typed out. Cut to the agent doing its job as a short log (three lines: task, action, result), then land the outcome as a single number or sentence. Say what the product does in the first two seconds and end on the repo or install command.
